تصل Ys VIII إلى Switch 2
في 25 فبراير 2027
dl.notes: Brief: hook = the date and platform in the headline; format clipcard (trailer and split at 4/4 for Wednesday); opener: the monster fight at 56 s moving under the headline; card «الأداء / حتى 120 / إطارًا في الثانية» over the trailer at 38 s, blurred (the figure lives only on the card); line 1 (what the game is) on Adol at the ship's railing, the ship at sea, Adol washed ashore: the game's hero and its sea voyage; line 2 (GameShare co-op) on the party fighting in the field and Adol's attack; under it the trailer's own score from 28 s (tonal, no subtitles on screen in that stretch; measured, not heard). 16.3 s. Source decode clean. Two shot sheets: removed a mid-shot cut, an English dialogue box cut by the crop, a midriff framing, a white flash; focus by hand on Adol. Arabic: both skills; glossary نينتيندو; Falcom as «فالكوم (Falcom)» (earlier use). DeepL forward: «بمعدل يصل إلى 120 إطارًا في الثانية» taken for the caption; back-check matched. Grammar: no required edits; NIS America as «إن آي إس أمريكا» (no glossary row). Cards drawn on the runner (cardgfx) since the container has no Dubai font. v1: card ground (38 s) read flat dark; v2: ground landed on the trailer's English GameShare screen (the footage ground runs from start plus the card's time); v3 ground 20.5 s, so 28 to 31 s, gameplay without text. v3 decode clean, no smear; co-op line in three short lines.
